userStories.title: Teach NLU extractor to tag non-travel messages as out_of_scope
userStories.description: As an extractor, I need to recognize when a user message is about a non-travel topic (electronics, shopping, gifts, fitness, credit cards, personal advice) and tag it so downstream layers can decline gracefully.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a rule to the system prompt in lib/agent/nlu-v2/extractor.ts: when the user message is clearly about a non-travel topic, set intent='chitchat' AND scenario=null AND append a string to planning_assumptions in the format 'out_of_scope: <brief topic>' (e.g. 'out_of_scope: electronics shopping')
The rule must list the 6 out-of-scope categories: electronics, shopping, gifts, fitness, credit cards, personal advice
Do not modify lib/agent/nlu-v2/types.ts (no new NluIntent or NluScenario values)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Teach NLU chat.ts to politely decline when out_of_scope tag is present
userStories.description: As the chat reply layer, when the state summary indicates an out_of_scope assumption, I need to reply politely in the user's language redirecting them to ChatGPT or Claude for non-travel topics.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a rule to the system prompt in lib/agent/nlu-v2/chat.ts: when state_summary contains a planning_assumption starting with 'out_of_scope:', reply politely that Onegent focuses on travel (restaurants, hotels, flights, activities, trip planning) and suggest ChatGPT or Claude for other topics. Respond in Chinese if the user's last message is Chinese, English otherwise.

Verify that buildStateSummary() in lib/agent/nlu-v2/router.ts includes planning_assumptions in its output so the chat layer can see them — if it does not, append them to the summary string (non-empty entries only)
Do not modify routeIntent() branching logic and do not add a new RouterAction variant
